work.title: Untitled (Target Panels, Studio)
work.description: Four large white panels lean against a studio wall, each featuring printed shooting-range targets with iridescent compact discs at their centers. Smaller concentric-ring targets appear below the large bullseyes, and additional works — including targets and palm-tree imagery — are visible on the wall behind.
work.composition: four panels in row, studio wall behind
